name: Music Theory for Guitarists
instructions: Understanding basic music theory (scales, keys, intervals) helps explain why certain chords sound good together.
Learn the idea of a "key" -- a set of notes and chords that naturally fit together, which is why songs often stick to a small chord family.
You do not need deep theory to play guitar well, but even a little makes learning new songs and chords far more intuitive.
Watch today's video for a beginner's guide to music theory.
